prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square 1:1 game card illustration for 浪掷风吟 (Wind-song freely cast). Completely recompose the scene from scratch using the character and style references. No card frame, text or UI.

REFERENCE ROLES: Inputs 1/2/3 ONLY establish drawing style: blue-and-gold portrait = broad opaque directional paint and grouped hair; dark-coat portrait = restrained fabric planes; brown-haired close portrait = anime eyes and economical facial structure. Borrow their brushwork grammar, never their characters, hats, outfits, weapons, text or watermarks. Input 4 ONLY establishes Xingyue's character identity and clothing; do not copy her pose or lantern.

ART DIRECTION: a symbolic card image on an ABSTRACT FLAT COLOR background. The entire background is made of three large clean alternating solid-color areas: pale warm-gray, muted blue-green, and darker slate-teal. Shape their boundaries as sweeping asymmetrical curves that support the song's circulation. Broad quiet surfaces; no landscape, horizon, riverbanks, mountains, sky, clouds, buildings, stage or environmental depth. Water and wind appear ONLY as a few symbolic painted gestures in the composition, not a real environment.

UNIQUE SHOT AND ACTION: the exact instant Xingyue casts her song into the wind. An expressive three-quarter side view with medium three-quarter-body framing, a subtle diagonal across the square. She turns her torso in a flowing countertwist, tilts her head gently back and toward the viewer, half-open gold eyes and a visibly open, small natural chanting mouth. Her nearer arm reaches toward the upper-left foreground with a softly upward-facing palm and relaxed separated fingers as if releasing the melody; her other hand is gathered near her sternum, fingers gently guiding the rhythm. Arms at distinct levels, natural shoulders and wrists. Avoid the previous symmetrical spread-arm stance. The long thick low braid, shoulder cape and large white skirt planes are blown into ONE powerful counter-curving sweep toward the opposite side, echoing the outward hand gesture. Face and both hands are fully readable and uncluttered, character fills roughly 78% of image height, head and hands leave clear margin.

SYMBOLIC ELEMENTS: a broad muted turquoise opaque brush-ribbon behind the torso, interrupted and curving around the outer edge, symbolizes a flowing river. A few pale ivory elongated crescent-shaped paint strokes sweep in the opposite layer and symbolize fierce wind. They are intentionally stylized abstract shapes, not glassy water, not a physical wave, not a real river channel, no foam spray or photoreal droplets. Arrange river and wind imagery in one open spiral that frames her movement but leaves her head untouched. Integrate the visual rhythm into the hair/cape motion, without decorative music notes, runes, spell circles or luminous particles. The pose itself carries '浪掷', her face carries '吟', and the sweeping interwoven gestures carry '风'.

CHARACTER: Xingyue, adult female priest in NORMAL form. Pale cream-gold very long hair, thick straight blunt bangs above brows, one side braid feeding a low thick long plait. Warm gold eyes. A white crescent moon hairpin clipped flat into the hair at the top of her head just above the bangs, slightly off-center to the viewer's right, tilted, resting against the hair (not floating, not a halo). White C-shaped crescent tips toward upper right. White modest priest dress with small high collar, gold neck ring, small gold four-point star brooch, subdued broad gold trim and layered skirt with teal underlayer. Deep teal-green short shoulder cape edged gold. Dark half-finger wrist guards; exposed fingers are natural skin color. No lantern, staff or sword. No purple eyes, silver hair, black moon clip or black-purple shadow outfit.

STYLE: hand-painted anime built from LARGE opaque color masses, broad directional curved or elongated brush strokes, confidently grouped hard-edged shadows and handmade boundaries. Match reference brush scale; selective overlaps and broken stroke endings, quiet interiors rather than all-over texture. Preserve volume without fine detailing. Cream-gold hair organized into a few coherent curved locks with quiet base colors, broad shadow turns and short irregular opaque highlights; the braid stays a clear grouped structure. No pale hair scratches, fine strand networks, micro-locks or facet mosaics. Clear anime eye shapes with simple gold iris masses and few highlights, economical open mouth/nose, clean cheek planes, readable bangs cast shadow, under-jaw shadow and neck turn, a few tapered colored structural lines. Cloth uses broad shoulder/chest/joint-aligned fold planes, few selective crease accents, quiet white and deep teal areas; no dense wrinkle network. Hands clear but economical. Matte cream white, colored gray shadows, subdued warm gold and deep teal; richer turquoise only in the symbolic river mark. Face and hand are selective focal detail, backdrop the simplest area. Avoid polished semi-realistic splash art, 3D gloss, airbrush gradients, detailed environment, uniform grain/canvas filters, tiny angular fragments, dense texture, excessive rim glow, evenly outlined vector art and extra clutter. No text, logos or watermark.
